description: Export through Onshape's translation service: STEP, IGES, 3MF, PARASOLID, SOLIDWORKS and others. Slower than STL because the translation is queued server-side.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

format.description: Format name, e.g. STEP, IGES, 3MF, PARASOLID (default STEP).

out.description: Output file path (default onshape-<timestamp>.<format> in the output directory).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_export
title: Export CAD format
